And we now expect our adjusted EPS to be $13.15 at the midpoint, representing about 25% growth versus fiscal 2025.

Q3 sales came in above our expectations.

source.quote: Free cash flow in Q3 of $654 million was above our expectations.

Lifecycle Services organic sales are expected to be up slightly year-over-year, while reported sales will be down high single-digits, with segment margin in the mid-teens, above the prior year.
For the full-year, Intelligent Devices sales are expected to grow mid-single-digits on an organic and reported basis, with segment margin expanding about 100 basis points year-over-year.
